facts.text: I asked what the old rock song is that has the main adlib "be hey".
I said the song is used in Happy Gilmore.
I asked about a musician named Redfoo and which version he remixed.
I said Redfoo used the song in "Party Rock Mondays" on YouTube.
I asked what version of the remixed song is in the YouTube video I linked.
I asked if I could be told all the remixed or raw songs in the video.
I corrected myself and said I meant using this link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tL4tde6uZ_Q&ab_channel=redfoo.
I asked for the songs but only to say it once.
